tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "1016D52243D1237C8EAE19ABBC44670A", "Danger! Killing a Protected player will Corrupt your soul-and make you a high-value target for PvP. Corruption incurs many restrictions and penalties.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "EDE69A7B4478355059BB8D82523F9709", "While Corrupt, you are a high value target and marked on the Mini-Map. Killing and Looting Corrupt players never causes Corruption.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "946E5D59455221C453CD14A51E1BA5BA", "You cannot Unequip Gear or Trade with other players. If Killed, you will drop additional Materials and some of your valuable Gear.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "901E2B4F4B0E407907F3379F6A91E99A", "You suffer from Combat penalties that reduce your capability to deal and mitigate Damage, especially against Protected players.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "D791EE3C4A7796A91F22B59BA8EC84C8", "Upon Death, you will have no sanctuary at Embersprings-and no choice of Respawn location. You\'ll also incur additional Experience Debt.")
NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "4CD5202F4BE27647284D47B8F1358D36", "Killing additional Protected players increases your level of Corruption-and all penalties grow with it.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "971C09174A48E7CFE9C7CEA5F25A1E54", "Killing additional Protected players also earns you Blight-a permanent stain on your soul that amplifies all future Corruption.")
NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "D78BFA3B49367CB927F076AE530DC6E0", "There are two ways to reduce your Corruption: Killing PvE Enemies, or Dying. For Blight there is no cure.")
